hero.title: Questions & Answers
hero.description: Everything you need to know about creating and publishing memories with Milestis.

items.question: What is Milestis?
items.answer: Milestis is a platform for creating digital photo books and interactive portfolios. With ready-made templates and decorative elements, you can build and publish your project in just a few minutes from your phone or computer.

items.question: Who is this service for?
items.answer: The platform is suitable for anyone who wants to beautifully preserve memories or create a digital gift, as well as for photographers and designers who need to quickly build a portfolio.

items.question: How does project publishing work?
items.answer: After publishing, the project receives a unique link on the milestis.site domain that can be shared with others. Project management and creation take place in the main platform interface.

items.question: Do I need an account to view my project?
items.answer: No. Anyone with the link can open and view the project without registration.

items.question: Can I edit my project after publishing?
items.answer: Yes. You can edit your project at any time, and all changes will be automatically updated via the link.

items.question: Can I delete my project?
items.answer: Yes, you can fully delete any project from your account. When a project is deleted, any spent funds and credits are not refunded.

items.question: How does payment work on the platform?
items.answer: We offer a credit system for one-time payments, as well as a subscription that unlocks additional features and reduces usage costs.

items.question: What happens to my projects if my subscription ends?
items.answer: All published projects will remain accessible via their links. Restrictions will only apply to creating new projects and using paid features until the subscription is renewed.
